states.do: Gates must pass before you change anything. Capture behavior to compare later: a sample run, a snapshot, or script output.
states.exit: the captured behavior and how to capture it again

states.do: Delete first (dead code, one-caller wrappers, stale flags) in its own commit. Then move in steps that each pass and get a commit. Script repetitive edits and keep the script. Migrate every caller of a new API and delete the old one. No shims.
states.exit: deletions, steps, commits, the script if any

states.do: Capture the baseline behavior again and compare. Any difference is a refactor bug.
states.exit: captured behavior matches baseline (how you compared)

states.do: Give `vstack brief --review` to a fresh reviewer and say behavior must be identical. Fix act-on items, then `vstack back verify` if code changed. Details: {skill}/review.md
Keep deletions, mechanical moves, and logic changes in separate commits. Push, open a PR, or merge only if the user authorized it.
states.exit: commit SHAs and PR link, or 'ready on branch <name>'
